description: Image Description: The image contains a single, simple geometric shape resembling the number "7" or a right-angled corner. It is composed of two straight line segments: one vertical and one horizontal, meeting at a right angle. The vertical segment extends downward from the top-left, and the horizontal segment extends to the right from the bottom of the vertical line. The lines are solid, black, and of uniform thickness. The background is plain white, with no additional elements, textures, or colors present
